visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed parallax image band (2:3 mobile, 2:1 desktop) with a bottom scrim or black veil and a large display h1 on the grid; optional intro copy, category label, slide caption with hairline rule, or embedded video.
contentPattern: Rows classified by content: picture(s) (desktop image, optional mobile crop), an h1 page title, optional paragraphs after it (intro copy, category label, bold-italic form-trigger button, or a linked slide caption).
usage: Use as the top hero of hub or offering pages: a full-width image with the page title.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image-led page hero by authoring a picture row and an h1 row, adding intro or label paragraphs and tint options as needed.
